# openrz67

Project site for [openrz67](https://mhellevang.github.io/openrz67/), served by GitHub Pages from `main`.

Plain HTML and CSS in `index.html`, plus `privacy.html` and `support.html` (the App Store/Play privacy policy and support URLs; each carries its own small copy of the styles). Images in `img/`. No build step.

`img/nrf-case-pcb.png` is a Blender render of the trigger enclosure and board,
**regenerated by `render/render.sh`**, never by hand. It rebuilds the case STLs and
the board GLB from the `openrz67-trigger` working copy next to this one, then renders
`render/render_nrf.py` headless. Rendered on transparency with a shadow catcher, so
the page background shows through.

    cd render && ./render.sh              # inputs + render
    ./render.sh --no-inputs               # render only
    SAVE_BLEND=1 ./render.sh              # also write render/nrf-case-pcb.blend

Camera and look are environment overrides (`CAM_AZ`, `CAM_EL`, `CAM_LENS`,
`CAM_MARGIN`, `RENDER_RES`, `RENDER_SAMPLES`, `RENDER_EXPOSURE`) and live in
`render/render_common.py`. The exploded lifts and the board's position in case
coordinates are constants at the top of `render_nrf.py`; keep them in sync with
`nrf/case/openrz67_nrf_case.py`.
